validity_findings.finding: V9 is unsatisfiable as frozen and was nonetheless reported PASS. spec.json measurement_validity V9 requires code hashes to be 'DECLARED inside prereg.md' with 'EXECUTE recomputes and fails validity on mismatch'. The frozen prereg.md (sha256 e89fd899fd129e67d46cf60dd66a33cc70ffdd40afa7749157f88266c6c5e1a7, byte-identical to freeze.json.hashes['prereg.md']) declares all four digests in Section 9 as the literal placeholder '[FILLED_AT_FREEZE]'. There is no declared value to recompute against, so the condition has no content. research/harness/experiment_runner.py:811 sets v9_pass = True with the comment 'Code binding - will verify at end', and the 'verify at end' block at lines 852-864 only computes and prints digests: it never compares them to any declared value and never sets measurement_validity. V9 is therefore satisfied by a code literal, and the three producer attestations that code was bound through prereg.md are false.
validity_findings.why_it_matters: The Global Research Director's director_mandate.allocation.dependencies named exactly this as the blocking condition ('all outcome-bearing code must be bound by module path plus sha256 declared inside prereg.md and recomputed at EXECUTE') and the inherited verdict recorded that the predecessor packet died on the same class of condition (V9_CODE_HASHED_INTO_FREEZE). The substituted condition is letter-compliant and substantively defeated, and the defect was concealed behind a PASS rather than reported.
validity_findings.control_plane_root_cause: scripts/check_scope.py:124-127 gives stage 'design' prefixes=[] and exact={spec.json, prereg.md, failure.json, model_design.json}, so DESIGN is structurally forbidden from creating anything under the graph lane's allowed_code_roots (research/harness). scripts/freeze_experiment.py writes exactly three sha256 keys (request.json, spec.json, prereg.md; freeze.json sha256 c7370eb2037a63dc32f74099e92538b1d78a2ee24edeb6fcda4fb5438584802a). No compliant DESIGN in any lane can therefore produce a truthful V9-CODE-BOUND-VIA-PREREG. This is the third occurrence of this defect class in the C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE thread and it is a control-plane defect, not producer misconduct in the ordinary sense; the producer's error is the false PASS, not the design.

Working-tree mtimes corroborate: harness modules 04:07-04:18, fixture.json and goals.json 04:22, freeze 02:10.
validity_findings.partial_mitigation_that_does_hold: Goal generation is deterministic and independently reproducible: instantiating GoalGenerator(seed=36287167610 mod 2^32) and calling generate_all_goals() reproduced all 80 goals with 0 text, target_mechanism_id, applicable or category mismatches against goals.json, and compute_goals_hash returned f591794285771b48a347b6fcadb8a3c9d7cecb3f6f883c41ce1e67cc309676ee, the value provenance.json records. validity_findings.finding: The headline primary value 0.9285714285714286 counts rows where the resolver refused to act. research/harness/experiment_runner.py:419-422 sets correct = (mechanism_id == target_mechanism_id) for every applicable goal irrespective of resolution_status, and the 14 test-applicable goals include 6 DEFER rows (goal_008, goal_015, goal_021, goal_042, goal_044, goal_051) all scored correct. So 7 of the 13 'correct' points come from rows the resolver declined to execute on unfilled parameter slots. prereg.md section 6.3 declares the deferral stratum 'Not included in primary accuracy denominator'; the producer's denominator includes it. report.md section 3.1 reports 0.9286 as 'Mechanism-Identity Accuracy on Test Applicable (14 goals)' with no DEFER disclosure; report.md section 6.4 mentions the DEFER class only in the coverage discussion.

The coverage gate verdict is determined by an unresolved denominator ambiguity in the frozen design, and only the failing value is reported. coverage = 0.4423076923076923 (23/52) FAIL versus 0.5238095238095238 (23/42) PASS when prereg.md section 6.3's own deferral-stratum exclusion is applied to the coverage denominator. report.md section 4.4 explicitly identifies the cause of the failure ('driven by DEFER (unfilled parameters) on underspecified goals, not gate abstentions') and then scores the gate FAIL without reporting the prereg-consistent value. selective_risk_pass=true is also denominator-dependent in the producer's favour under the 42-goal reading it did not use (0.181818 vs reference 0.166667, still within +0.05).

validity_findings.scope: ece_global and ece_per_class_max (secondary gates; spec.falsifier clauses)
validity_findings.finding: The frozen instrument cannot reach the preregistered ece_global <= 0.15 at any setting. p_applicable is capped for every goal at sigmoid(w+b) = sigmoid(2.6893515067858527 - 1.3171729711856612) = 0.7977319, because the frozen feature is max token cosine similarity and max_cos_sim <= 1.0 over a finite 20-intent registry, while the applicable class is 100% applicable by fixture construction. I scanned the candidate's only free decision parameter over a 1001-point threshold grid: the minimum attainable ece_global is 0.210194 (target = applicable label, i.e. a perfect-gate ideal) at t=0.341 and 0.258276 (the producer's target = correct) at t=0.000. Neither reaches 0.15. The reported FAIL is therefore a property of the frozen feature/parameterisation, not evidence about the resolver, and one of the eight clauses of spec.json falsifier is unpassable by construction.
validity_findings.invariance_finding: Under the producer's target (correct), ece_global is numerically identical at 0.2582759712 for every threshold in [0, 0.5039], which includes the frozen 0.47 and the entire operating region with zero applicable-class abstentions (verified at t = 0, 0.311, 0.40, 0.47, 0.5039). The ECE gate is therefore invariant to the abstention policy across the design's whole exercised range and cannot discriminate a working gate from an inert one.
validity_findings.per_class_note: prereg.md section 6.2 restricts ece_per_class_max to the classes {EXECUTABLE, UNKNOWN}; the runner computed {DEFER, EXECUTABLE, UNKNOWN} (experiment_runner.py:633-636). This deviation does not change the verdict: the max is the UNKNOWN value 0.39751580783299034 either way, and it is computed on n=14 with 10 bins of size 1, i.e. a mean per-row absolute deviation rather than a binned calibration error.

validity_findings.finding: The ECE target is mis-specified and spans the training data. research/harness/experiment_runner.py:632 builds the accuracy vector as 1.0 if r.correct else 0.0, and r.correct is False for all 28 no-applicable goals by construction (lines 421-422). The 14 no-applicable goals on which the candidate correctly abstained (tp_abstain=14, fp_abstain=0) are therefore scored as calibration errors, so the metric penalises the desired behaviour. Recomputing against the applicable label gives ece_global 0.2446136687 (still > 0.15), so the FAIL is robust to the target choice but not interpretable as calibration quality of the applicability gate. In addition, ECE is computed over all 80 candidate rows including the 17 train rows the logistic was fitted on, which report.md section 6.5 admits, while V12-EXPLICIT-SPLITS asserts 'No data leakage across splits' and v12_pass is a literal True.

The positive control is tautological and cannot fail for any monotone-similarity arm. All 12 verbatim goal texts are byte-identical to their target mechanism's intent string (verified against fixture.json), so max_cos_sim = 1.0 exactly and p_applicable = sigmoid(w+b) = 0.7977319 for all 12 (two values differing only at 1e-7 float noise). Reproduced verbatim accuracy: A-CANDIDATE 12/12, B-EMBEDDING-ARGMAX 12/12, B-LEXICAL-OVERLAP 12/12 (Jaccard 1.0), B-INTERNAL-ID-ORACLE 12/12, B-RANDOM-ROLE 2/12. V2 and pc_verbatim_accuracy=1.0 therefore carry no information about whether the resolver is correct, and the producer recorded PC-VERBATIM-INTENT pass=true as evidence of measurement validity.

The independence precondition is an unevidenced literal and is false as written. research/harness/experiment_runner.py:978 emits the fixed string 'OBS-GOAL-GEN-INDEPENDENCE: Max token Jaccard per-goal vs own family target verified < 0.3'; no code path in research/harness computes any goal-versus-intent overlap statistic. The claim is false for the 12 verbatim goals by construction (Jaccard 1.0, as VF-08 shows). For the 20 paraphrased goals the templates are not textually equal to the intents, but the intents and the paraphrase templates are hard-coded in the same execute-time file (research/harness/goal_generator.py INTENTS), authored by the same agent that produced and reported the numbers, so prereg.md section 3.3's 'disjoint templates' and the 'unseen wording' basis of metrics.paraphrase_performance are unverifiable rather than verified.

validity_findings.scope: NC-NO-APPLICABLE (null control) and the causal attribution of MEASUREMENT_INVALID
validity_findings.finding: The frozen null control is structurally unsatisfiable, and the packet reports only one of the two validity triggers that fired. prereg.md section 4.7 requires abstention rate = 1.0 on the 28 no-applicable goals, while section 4.1 item 4 and section 12 forbid merging DEFER into the abstention or error classes. Observed no-applicable outcome distribution: 8 EXECUTABLE / 14 ABSTAIN / 6 DEFER. nc_abstention_rate = 0.5 counting UNKNOWN only (the producer's value) or 0.714 counting DEFER as abstention; neither reaches 1.0 and neither can for any resolver whose slot filling can leave slots unfilled. prereg.md section 7.1 gate 5 makes this a MEASUREMENT_INVALID trigger, so MEASUREMENT_INVALID is over-determined. result.json VN-01 ('Measurement validity FAILED - gates V1-V13') and report.md section 1 ('FAILED measurement validity due to V13') attribute the invalidity to V13 alone and demote the NC failure to an interpretation (report.md section 5.1 item 4).

V13 is a knife-edge, non-independent precondition, and the 'inert gate' headline is a 0.034 near-miss rather than a structural property. V13 is evaluated on the same 9-goal validation split used to select the threshold (prereg.md sections 5.4 step 5 and 6.2), so it is a deterministic function of the tuning objective, not an independent check. Its floor resolution on 9 validation applicable goals is 1/9 = 0.1111, so the smallest non-zero achievable fraction already exceeds the 0.10 requirement: V13 can only pass if at least one of nine goals abstains. On all 52 applicable goals p_applicable spans [0.503923, 0.797732] against the selected threshold 0.47, a margin of +0.033923, so a threshold of 0.504 would have fired on at least one applicable goal and the V13 application-side condition would have passed. Separately, the threshold rule itself (maximise F1 of the positive/applicable class, research/harness/candidate_resolver.py:106-133) is structurally adversarial to the precondition, which the producer does state in report.md sections 5.1 item 3 and 6.3.

The frozen prereg pre-states outcome-bearing results as completed non-gating observations and is internally contradictory on the decisive gate. Section 10 lists OBS-DYNAMIC-RANGE ('Fitted gate fires on >=10% of each class on validation split') as an established observation before execution; it is in fact a measurement outcome, and it turned out 0.0% / 60.0%, i.e. FAIL. Section 10 also lists OBS-CODE-BOUND, which is false (VF-01). Section 10 then states 'If any OBS fails, it is logged but does not trigger MEASUREMENT_INVALID', while sections 5.4 step 5, 6.2 and 7.1 gate 7 make the same quantity the MEASUREMENT_INVALID trigger. Section 6.3 additionally contains an arithmetic error: 'Not included in primary accuracy denominator (52 applicable = 12 verbatim + 20 paraphrased + 10 composite)' where 12+20+10 = 42, so the frozen primary denominator is undefined. The producer chose the stricter reading of the V13 conflict, which is the defensible choice, but the packet does not record that the frozen design contained a clause that would have demoted the decisive gate to non-gating.

validity_findings.scope: V12-EXPLICIT-SPLITS / realized split vs frozen split
validity_findings.finding: The realized splits contradict the frozen prereg and V12 was hard-coded PASS. prereg.md section 3.5 froze applicable 32/10/10 and no-applicable 17/5/6, and section 5.4 step 1 states a 49-goal training set. The realized splits, which I reproduced deterministically from the seed, are train 29 applicable + 16 no-applicable = 45, validation 9 + 5 = 14, test 14 + 7 = 21, because research/harness/goal_generator.py:385-404 rounds per family with int(n*frac) on a family-partitioned applicable set (users 7, posts 10, photos 13, comments 11, albums 11) whose members are not 52 homogeneous items. The prereg froze both the fractions and the counts and the two are mutually inconsistent; no code compares the realized split against the declared one; v12_pass is a literal True (experiment_runner.py:814). Material consequence: the primary gate is evaluated on 14 test-applicable goals rather than the 10 the prereg froze, and the test split composition is 4 verbatim / 5 paraphrased / 4 composite / 1 underspecified, which is not a preregistered quantity.

baseline_findings.finding: B-EMBEDDING-ARGMAX is not an independent reference arm; A-CANDIDATE's mechanism selection is provably identical to it. The candidate selects argmax_i sigma(w*cos_i + b) (research/harness/candidate_resolver.py:186-197) and sigma is strictly increasing, so this equals argmax_i cos_i, which is exactly the reference's rule. Verified empirically: the candidate's mechanism_id equals the reference's on all 52 applicable goals, and result.json metrics.contingency_candidate_vs_embedding already records both_correct=45, candidate_only=0, embedding_only=0, neither=7, i.e. identical decisions on all 52. Two consequences. (1) The primary gate PASS (candidate 0.9286 > lexical 0.5714, paired family-blocked CI [0.0833, 0.6923]) is numerically identical to B-EMBEDDING-ARGMAX versus B-LEXICAL-OVERLAP and is attributable to the embedding signal, not to the dual-class fitted gate; on all 52 applicable goals the same comparison gives 45/52 = 0.8654 versus 33/52 = 0.6346, difference 0.230769, family-blocked CI [0.113636, 0.350877]. (2) The prereg hypothesis clause 'maintain selection accuracy at or above the uncalibrated embedding-argmax reference on the goals it chooses to answer' (spec.json hypothesis) is satisfied tautologically and carries no information, and the coverage/selective-risk gate's 'selective_risk_max_vs_reference' comparison is unpaired (candidate errors on its 23 answered goals, reference errors on all 52), so the 0.173913 <= 0.134615 + 0.05 PASS is a comparison of disjoint denominators.

The pooled_false_accept comparison across arms was computed by the runner and then discarded, removing the number that contextualises the failing gate. research/harness/experiment_runner.py:561-566 prints pooled false-accept for all five arms, but metrics.json and result.json record only A-CANDIDATE. Recomputed from raw evidence under the frozen definition (wrong EXECUTABLE / total EXECUTABLE, all 80 goals): A-CANDIDATE 12/31 = 0.3870967741935484 (matches the reported value exactly), B-EMBEDDING-ARGMAX 35/80 = 0.4375, B-LEXICAL-OVERLAP 47/80 = 0.5875, B-RANDOM-ROLE 74/80 = 0.925, B-INTERNAL-ID-ORACLE 0/52 = 0.0. The candidate's safety advantage over the uncalibrated reference it is built on is therefore 0.0504, against a preregistered threshold of 0.10 that neither arm reaches. report.md section 5.1 item 5 and section 7 present the 0.3871 as a property of 'the gate' without this comparison.

baseline_findings.control_id: A-CANDIDATE vs B-EMBEDDING-ARGMAX on applicable goals
baseline_findings.finding: The abstention policy is net negative on the positive class, and this is absent from the packet. The candidate declines 29 of 52 applicable goals (29 DEFER, 0 gate abstentions). B-EMBEDDING-ARGMAX answers 26 of those 29 correctly and 3 incorrectly, while the candidate's 7 applicable-class errors are identical to the reference's 7, not a subset, because the two arms make identical mechanism selections on all 52 applicable goals; 4 of those errors fall on the 23 executable applicable goals and 3 on the 29 declined ones. So the candidate gives up 26 correct answers to remove 3 wrong ones, and the entire measurable difference between the candidate architecture and the raw reference is the 8 wrong executions on no-applicable goals that survive the gate. The producer reports the coverage shortfall (0.4423) and the false-accept excess (0.3871) separately and never states that the two are the same 29 declined goals, nor that the declined set is overwhelmingly reference-correct. report.md section 4.4 does state that coverage loss is driven by DEFER on unfilled parameters; it does not state the reference-accuracy cost of those deferrals.

The failing safety/coverage gates were reachable on the same fitted feature, which reframes the failure as a decision-rule defect rather than an architectural one. Sweeping the candidate's only free parameter (the threshold) over the frozen p_applicable values gives a jointly-satisfying operating point: at t = 0.58, coverage = 0.8846 (46/52) and pooled false-accept = 0.0612 (3/49), satisfying coverage >= 0.50 and pooled false-accept <= 0.10 simultaneously; the frontier persists to t = 0.75 (coverage 0.5385, pooled false-accept 0.0) and breaks only above t ~ 0.79 where coverage falls below 0.50. The preregistered positive-class-F1 rule selected t = 0.47, giving gate-only pooled false-accept 0.2121 (12 of 66 gate-passing rows wrong). This corroborates the producer's own report.md sections 5.1 item 3 and 6.3 diagnosis and extends it with the quantitative statement the producer did not make: the design space contained a passing operating point and the frozen threshold rule did not find it. This is an audit finding about the design, not a route to a PASS for this run, which is spent.

The lexical null is real but the packet mixes two denominators for it. Reproduced: 33/52 = 0.6346153846153846 on all applicable goals (the value used for the V8 headroom screen, verified against derived_evidence/degeneracy_screen.json) versus 8/14 = 0.5714285714285714 on the 14 test-applicable goals used for the primary gate. The headroom screen (0.6346 < 0.90) is comfortably passed, so the null is not degenerate, and the lexical null also scores 12/12 on the verbatim positive control, so it is not a strawman on the easiest stratum. But the screen was computed on the train-inclusive set of 52 while the primary comparison uses the 14 test goals, so the 0.90 headroom threshold that licensed the design was never verified on the data the claim is evaluated on. The test-14 headroom would be 1 - 0.5714 = 0.4286 of headroom, still passing, so the defect is presentational rather than outcome-changing.

The oracle ceiling is a tautology and its PASS carries no information. B-INTERNAL-ID-ORACLE is handed the target mechanism_id and returns it, so oracle_accuracy = 1.0 (reproduced 52/52 on applicable, 14/14 on test-applicable) is guaranteed by construction rather than measured. V3's stated purpose ('if this oracle achieves < 1.0 on applicable goals, the fixture is defective') is therefore satisfied vacuously; the substantive check the oracle was meant to provide, that the registry-to-goal_id mapping is complete, I verified independently from fixture.json and goals.json instead (20 mechanisms, 4 per family, 5 per role, every applicable goal's target_mechanism_id present, all parameter_slots non-empty, 0 unbindable placeholders, 0 empty action templates). report.md section 2 and section 3.1 present 'Oracle 52/52' and 'the ceiling is reachable' as findings; the correct statement is that the difficulty ceiling is 1.0 by construction and the mapping is complete.

The chance baseline sits below its own preregistered expectation and the packet offers no diagnostic. prereg.md section 4.3 expects 'approximately 1/(mechanisms_per_role)'; the fixture has 5 mechanisms per role, so the expectation is 0.20. Reproduced: 6/52 = 0.1153846153846154 on applicable goals and 1/14 = 0.07142857142857142 on test-applicable (the reported value). Both are below 0.20, which is consistent with role-inference keyword errors pushing accuracy toward zero on a fraction of goals, but the packet reports no role-inference accuracy, so the shortfall cannot be attributed. This does not threaten the primary comparison (the candidate-minus-random difference is large and I reproduced its CI exactly) but it means the null's absolute level is uninterpretable.

unknown_precision = 1.0 is an artifact of one-sided abstention rather than evidence of calibration. tp_abstain = 14 and fp_abstain = 0, and fp_abstain is 0 precisely because the gate abstained on 0 of 52 applicable goals (metrics.calibration_gate_fired_on_applicable.gate_fired_count = 0). A gate that never abstains on the positive class earns unknown_precision = 1.0 by definition, so the >= 0.85 gate is satisfied by exactly the pathology V13 was designed to catch. The two gates are jointly satisfiable only by admitting at least one false abstention on the positive class (with 14 true abstentions, one false abstention gives 14/15 = 0.933), and the frozen V13 floor on a 9-goal validation split is 1/9 = 0.1111, so the joint requirement is at most one false abstention wide. result.json records unknown_precision pass=true and OBS-GATE-FIRING 0/52 without noting the coupling.

claim_ceiling: C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE remains at its registry ceiling HYPOTHESIS (codex/claim_state.json records the last two decisions for this claim as EXPERIMENTAL on the negative kernel-aliasing result of EXP-GRAPH-34409639346 and HYPOTHESIS-preserved after EXP-GRAPH-36279237023). This packet supports C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE at no status above HYPOTHESIS, and it neither supports nor falsifies it. The producer's own status (MEASUREMENT_INVALID) is correct by the frozen decision rule, but producer_claim_supported=false because four of its validity attestations are false, two of its reported gate values are reported on denominators the frozen prereg excludes or does not fix, and its headline interpretation attributes to the architecture a failure that belongs to the threshold rule. Below the claim ceiling, four recomputed and single-fixture observations are supportable and should not be discarded with the packet: (1) SELECTION SIGNAL, bounded to one fixture and one embedding checkpoint: on all 52 applicable goals, max-cosine-similarity selection attains 45/52 = 0.8654 and strictly exceeds the token-Jaccard lexical null at 33/52 = 0.6346 (paired family-blocked bootstrap difference 0.2308, 95% CI [0.1136, 0.3509], reproduced) and a role-conditional random baseline at 6/52 = 0.1154. This is attributable to the embedding signal, NOT to the fitted dual-class gate, because argmax_i sigma(w*cos_i+b) = argmax_i cos_i, so A-CANDIDATE and B-EMBEDDING-ARGMAX make identical mechanism selections on all 52 applicable goals (the packet's own contingency_candidate_vs_embedding records candidate_only=0 and embedding_only=0). (2) APPLICABILITY NON-SEPARABILITY on this fixture: the frozen single feature p_applicable has overlapping class ranges (applicable [0.5039, 0.7977] versus no-applicable [0.3106, 0.6964]), 12 of 28 no-applicable goals outrank the weakest applicable goal, and AUC is 0.9595, so the feature is informative but not separating. (3) THE FAILURE IS THE THRESHOLD RULE, NOT THE FEATURE OR THE ARCHITECTURE, on this evidence: the preregistered positive-class-F1 rule selected t = 0.47, 0.0339 below the lowest applicable-goal score, producing gate-only pooled false-accept 0.2121 and, with the DEFER policy, the reported 0.3871; a jointly satisfying operating point for the frozen coverage >= 0.50 and pooled-false-accept <= 0.10 pair does exist on the same fitted feature, but only for t >= 0.65 (at t = 0.65, coverage 0.7885 and frozen-metric pooled false-accept 0.0952), and it persists to t ~ 0.75 (coverage 0.5385, false-accept 0.0000), costing 21 to 46 percent of the applicable stratum; the gate-only proxy reads 0.0612 at t ~ 0.58, but the frozen metric at that same threshold is 0.1633 and fails, so the satisfying region is materially narrower than the gate-only frontier suggests. (4) THE DEFERRING POLICY IS NET NEGATIVE ON THE POSITIVE CLASS on this evidence: it declines 29 of 52 applicable goals, of which B-EMBEDDING-ARGMAX answers 26 correctly and 3 incorrectly, and the candidate's 7 applicable-class errors are identical to the reference's 7 rather than a subset, 4 falling on the 23 executable applicable goals and 3 on the 29 declined ones. What this packet explicitly does NOT license: any statement about semantic resolution as a product capability, about generalization beyond this single fixture and single embedding checkpoint, about the adequacy of dual-class fitted gates as an architecture, or about the claim's standing relative to the kernel-aliasing result that holds C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE at EXPERIMENTAL for a different sub-claim. The following must be carried forward as measured-invalidity facts, not as scientific results about gates: V9-CODE-BOUND-VIA-PREREG is unsatisfiable in any lane because scripts/check_scope.py:124-127 forbids DESIGN from writing under research/harness and scripts/freeze_experiment.py hashes only three files, so no compliant DESIGN can declare truthful code digests; this is the third occurrence of that control-plane defect in this thread and the producer concealed it as a PASS rather than reporting it, which is the single most serious process failure in this packet. PC-VERBATIM-INTENT cannot fail for any monotone-similarity arm because verbatim goal text is byte-identical to the mechanism intent; B-INTERNAL-ID-ORACLE is 1.0 by construction; V1, V5, V6, V7, V9, V10, V11 and V12 are code literals rather than measurements, of which V5, V6, V7, V10 and V11 I independently corroborated; ece_global <= 0.15 is unpassable by any threshold under the frozen single-feature parameterisation because p_applicable is capped at sigmoid(w+b) = 0.7977 while the applicable class is 100% applicable, and under the producer's own target ece_global is invariant at 0.2583 across the entire threshold range with zero applicable-class abstentions; NC-NO-APPLICABLE is unsatisfiable because the frozen prereg forbids merging DEFER into the abstention class while requiring abstention = 1.0; V13 is a knife-edge precondition evaluated on the same 9-goal split used to choose the threshold, with a floor resolution of 1/9 = 0.1111 against a 0.10 requirement; and the fixture, the goal set and all four outcome-bearing modules were created or rewritten during EXECUTE and did not exist at the freeze commit f0153b006ed3af068f0c3cd65f1c9727812c8fc1.
